result.reason: The operative insurance provision reaches the preferred position: CGL USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M for IBM’s handling of customer content and personal information, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It is not minimal because it unnecessarily reorders existing provisions and adds a one-year post-termination coverage requirement not required by the playbook. Unrelated substantive language remains unchanged, but drafting quality is reduced by the misplaced “Insurance” heading and the unnecessary tail requirement.
